Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 57545 of 2022
Applicant :- Gopal Shukla

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shardeshwar Mishra,Jitendra Rana

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Gopal Shukla with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 837 of 2019, u/s 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., P.S.
Kotwali Deoria, District Deoria, during pendency of the trial.

It is alleged in the FIR that the informant-Bank, on receiving quotations for loan purchasing "Three wheeler" auto vehicles from accused persons No. 2 to 12 (named in the F.I.R.), sanctioned loan and deposited the loan amount in accounts of accused No. 2 to 12, thereafter, sent the amount through UTR from account of accused Nos. 2 to 12 (including applicant) to dealer of auto vehicles co-accused No.1 and authorized dealer provided the bank/informant forged R.C. of "Three wheeler" auto vehicles.
Gopal Shukla vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11987014/
1

entities.text: Gopal Shukla vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
F.I.R. is delayed by 5 years.

It is further submitted that the authorized dealer, after receiving the amount from the Bank, did not release any vehicle in favour of the applicant but it appears that the informant, in collusion with the co-accused Ashok Chauhan (authorized dealer of the vehicles), embezzled the amount and to save himself lodged the instant F.I.R. making the applicant accused therein.
It is also submitted that the applicant has not applied for loan in the bank for purchasing "Three wheeler".
Applicant and his wife are disabled .
There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 17.10.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Constitution of India, Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Gopal Shukla, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 20.1.2023 Vandana  Gopal Shukla vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11987014/
